panels.description: Anthropic's billed Claude API cost for the current calendar month (UTC days, whatever the selected range), every API key and workspace of the organization, against the owner's US$200 monthly limit: Month to date in USD and Limit used (orange from 80 %, red from 100 %). targets.root_selector:
# Anthropic Claude API billed cost of the current calendar month (UTC days) against the owner's monthly limit of
# US$200 (cost_report without group_by over the month to date). Amounts are US cents as decimal strings.
# A bucket outside the current UTC month (the Bangkok month start falls on the previous UTC day) is left out.
# One row: Month to date in USD and Limit used in percent; a month without spending is 0, never no data.
# A truncated report is an error, not an undercount.
if .has_more then error("Anthropic cost report has more pages; the month needs more than 31 daily buckets")
elif (.data | type) != "array" then error("Anthropic cost report unavailable")
else (now | strftime("%Y-%m")) as $month
  | (([.data[] | select((.starting_at // "")[0:7] == $month) | .results[]? | .amount | tonumber] | add // 0) / 100) as $usd
  | {USD: $usd, Share: ($usd / 200 * 100)}
end

panels.description: SGD. BigQuery billing export for the selected dates grouped by service: cost before credits per service (Vertex AI is the variable line) and one Credits row, so the total is the net cost. Same 100 MB billed-query cap; a missing export shows no rows, not zero.

targets.root_selector:
# BigQuery billing export grouped into MW Credit service categories (columns
# Service, Gross, Credits, Currency). Rows: each category's cost before credits,
# descending, then one Credits row, so the column total is the net SGD cost.
# A missing export table gives no rows (Unavailable, not zero).
if (.jobComplete != true) then error("Billing query is still running; refresh later")
elif .pageToken then error("Billing result truncated; shorten time range")
elif any(.rows[]?; .f[3].v != "SGD") then error("Unexpected GCP currency")
else
  [.rows[]? | select(.f[0].v != null) |
    {Service: .f[0].v, Gross: (.f[1].v | tonumber), Credits: (.f[2].v | tonumber)}] as $rows |
  if ($rows | length) == 0 then empty else
    ($rows | sort_by(-.Gross) | map({Service, SGD: .Gross})[]),
    {Service: "Credits", SGD: ($rows | map(.Credits) | add)}
  end
end

panels.description: The selected range (month to date by default): chat turns (Turns = answered and failed, as on Now and PWA & APIs; a question that got no reply is not counted), failed turns (orange above 0) and the estimated cost, in total and per turn, from monitoring.pwa_chat_usage_v1, read live from loan_manager_prod through Grafana PDC (not stored in Cloud Monitoring). Cost = input, cached input and output + thinking tokens (thinking bills as output; every round of a turn, tool calls included) at the billed Vertex AI unit prices in model-prices.json, SGD per million tokens: gemini-4-argon S$5.11 input, S$0.26 cached, S$25.56 output; gemini-3.8-flash S$1.92 input, S$0.19 cached, S$9.59 output; gemini-3.5-flash S$1.91 input, S$0.19 cached, S$11.50 output. A model without a price shows No price. An estimate: the billed truth is the Vertex AI line of GCP by service · net.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(sum(u.turns), 0) AS "Turns", coalesce(sum(u.failed), 0) AS "Failed",
  CASE WHEN bool_or(p.model IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(round(sum(((u.input_tokens - coalesce(u.cached_tokens, 0)) * p.input + coalesce(u.cached_tokens, 0) * p.cached
    + (u.output_tokens + coalesce(u.thinking_tokens, 0)) * p.output) / 1000000.0), 2), 0) END AS "Est. cost",
  CASE WHEN bool_or(p.model IS NULL) OR coalesce(sum(u.turns), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE round(sum(((u.input_tokens - coalesce(u.cached_tokens, 0)) * p.input + coalesce(u.cached_tokens, 0) * p.cached
    + (u.output_tokens + coalesce(u.thinking_tokens, 0)) * p.output) / 1000000.0) / sum(u.turns), 4) END AS "Per turn"
FROM monitoring.pwa_chat_usage_v1($__timeFrom()) u
LEFT JOIN (VALUES ('gemini-4-argon', 5.1125, 0.2556, 25.5617), ('gemini-3.8-flash', 1.9172, 0.1917, 9.5857), ('gemini-3.5-flash', 1.9132, 0.1913, 11.5)) AS p(model, input, cached, output) ON p.model = u.model

panels.description: One row per model over the selected range (month to date by default) from monitoring.pwa_chat_usage_v1, read live from loan_manager_prod through Grafana PDC (not stored in Cloud Monitoring): turns, failed turns (orange above 0), Input = uncached input tokens, Cached = cached input, Output + thinking = generated tokens, and the estimated cost. Cost = input, cached input and output + thinking tokens (thinking bills as output; every round of a turn, tool calls included) at the billed Vertex AI unit prices in model-prices.json, SGD per million tokens: gemini-4-argon S$5.11 input, S$0.26 cached, S$25.56 output; gemini-3.8-flash S$1.92 input, S$0.19 cached, S$9.59 output; gemini-3.5-flash S$1.91 input, S$0.19 cached, S$11.50 output. The footer sums the cost.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.model AS "Model", u.turns AS "Turns", u.failed AS "Failed",
  u.input_tokens - coalesce(u.cached_tokens, 0) AS "Input", u.cached_tokens AS "Cached",
  u.output_tokens + coalesce(u.thinking_tokens, 0) AS "Output + thinking",
  round(((u.input_tokens - coalesce(u.cached_tokens, 0)) * p.input + coalesce(u.cached_tokens, 0) * p.cached
    + (u.output_tokens + coalesce(u.thinking_tokens, 0)) * p.output) / 1000000.0, 4) AS "Cost (SGD)"
FROM monitoring.pwa_chat_usage_v1($__timeFrom()) u
LEFT JOIN (VALUES ('gemini-4-argon', 5.1125, 0.2556, 25.5617), ('gemini-3.8-flash', 1.9172, 0.1917, 9.5857), ('gemini-3.5-flash', 1.9132, 0.1913, 11.5)) AS p(model, input, cached, output) ON p.model = u.model
ORDER BY u.turns DESC, u.model

panels.description: The 10 latest in-app chat questions (Chat in the PWA), newest first, from monitoring.pwa_chat_recent_turns_v1, read live from loan_manager_prod through Grafana PDC (not stored in Cloud Monitoring). Outcome = Answered, the error the asker saw (orange), No reply (the claim expired without one) or Pending; Rounds = model rounds; Time = the turn's duration; Input = uncached input tokens; Output = generated tokens including thinking. Cost = input, cached input and output + thinking tokens (thinking bills as output; every round of a turn, tool calls included) at the billed Vertex AI unit prices in model-prices.json, SGD per million tokens: gemini-4-argon S$5.11 input, S$0.26 cached, S$25.56 output; gemini-3.8-flash S$1.92 input, S$0.19 cached, S$9.59 output; gemini-3.5-flash S$1.91 input, S$0.19 cached, S$11.50 output. The footer sums the listed questions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT q.asked_at AS "Asked", q.question AS "Question", q.model AS "Model",
  CASE WHEN q.status = 'failed' THEN q.error_code ELSE q.status END AS "Outcome",
  q.rounds AS "Rounds", q.latency_ms / 1000.0 AS "Time",
  q.input_tokens - coalesce(q.cached_tokens, 0) AS "Input", q.output_tokens + coalesce(q.thinking_tokens, 0) AS "Output",
  round(((q.input_tokens - coalesce(q.cached_tokens, 0)) * p.input + coalesce(q.cached_tokens, 0) * p.cached
    + (q.output_tokens + coalesce(q.thinking_tokens, 0)) * p.output) / 1000000.0, 4) AS "Cost (SGD)"
FROM monitoring.pwa_chat_recent_turns_v1(10) q
LEFT JOIN (VALUES ('gemini-4-argon', 5.1125, 0.2556, 25.5617), ('gemini-3.8-flash', 1.9172, 0.1917, 9.5857), ('gemini-3.5-flash', 1.9132, 0.1913, 11.5)) AS p(model, input, cached, output) ON p.model = q.model
ORDER BY q.asked_at DESC

targets.root_selector:
# Anthropic Claude API billed cost by model and cost type over the selected days (cost_report with
